o1.title: Severe pneumonia or very severe disease
o1.note: Give first dose of antibiotic. Refer URGENTLY to the health facility.

o2.title: Pneumonia
o2.note: Give oral amoxicillin. Advise the caregiver when to return.

o3.title: No pneumonia: cough or cold
o3.note: Soothe the throat. Advise the caregiver when to return.
